title: wt new brief carries the ticket's related files with their public signatures and the help agents keep re-reading, to cut model round trips
description: Model round trips are 77% of agent time: 5105 turns at about 8 s, most turns issuing one grep, Read or Edit; agents re-read the same help (run-scene --help 14 times, generate_board update --help 9, wt launch-add --help 8). Evidence: ai-workspace reports/tool-review-2026-10-18.md items 2 and 16. Extend the brief ixd wt new prints with each related file's path, package and public signatures (from a quick parse, capped), the callers of the ticket's named classes, and the condensed usage of run-scene, launch-add, generate_board update and the routes the ticket names.
definition-of-done:
1. The wt new brief lists the related files with their public signatures and the key command usage.
2. Measured on two tickets: turns before the first edit, against a comparable earlier ticket.
testing-plan: 1. Print the brief for a mesh ticket and a UI ticket; paste them.
